verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Drop-in Element for web checkout, initialized with createElement(...), that accepts appearance and layout options and adapts its input fields by payment method and country. It also documents embedded checkout and elements as alternatives to its hosted page, so components can sit in the developer's own site rather than redirecting. missing for 10: detail on individual (non drop-in) elements and native mobile/app embedding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Pass appearance and layout in createElement(...). For examples and supported values, see Customize style and appearance
Automatically adjusts input fields to collect information based on the payment method and country.
hosted page, embedded checkout, and elements
